subject: Indonesia
note: Hand-curated research for a Geographica episode about Indonesia. Claims are cited to a pinned Wikipedia revision (trusted_secondary). The article gives the island count as a range (13,000 to 17,000), and the episode says so.

claims.text: Indonesia comprises between 13,000 and 17,000 islands, including Sumatra, Java, Sulawesi, and parts of Borneo and New Guinea.
It is the world’s largest archipelagic state and the 14th-largest country by area.
Indonesia ranks fourth in the world by population, with over 280 million people.
It lies in Southeast Asia and Oceania, between the Indian and Pacific oceans.
